Give official approval to something.

cartes.aide: Resolve small problems or details.

cartes.aide: Add details to an idea or plan.

cartes.aide: Give your opinion in a discussion.

That decision belongs to someone more senior.

cartes.aide: Think creatively, in an unusual way.

cartes.aide: We can't pay for it.

cartes.aide: In spite of (formal).

cartes.aide: Even so; introduces a contrasting point.

cartes.aide: I understand and accept what you're saying.

cartes.aide: Generally; on the whole.

cartes.aide: Convincing; powerful enough to hold your attention.

cartes.aide: Doubtful; probably not true or honest.

cartes.aide: A point no longer worth discussing.

cartes.aide: A warning or condition attached to a statement.

cartes.aide: To the extent that (formal).

cartes.aide: Partly; not completely.

cartes.aide: Looking at the other side of the situation.

cartes.aide: A small step that leads to worse and worse consequences.

cartes.aide: A distorted version of someone's argument, easy to attack.

cartes.aide: Raise a question (common use); assume what you're trying to prove (strict use).

cartes.aide: Choose only the facts that support your view.

cartes.aide: Wrongly treat two different things as the same.

cartes.aide: Prove that a claim is wrong.

cartes.aide: Admit that something is true, often reluctantly.

cartes.aide: Very weak or slight.

cartes.aide: Showing subtle differences; not black and white.

cartes.aide: The opposite of what you would expect.

cartes.aide: Something with both good and bad effects.

cartes.aide: An obvious problem nobody wants to mention.

cartes.aide: Exclude a possibility.

cartes.aide: Be, in essence, about one main thing.

cartes.aide: Be caused by; originate in.

cartes.aide: You're right about that.

Panic or get very upset.

cartes.reponse: We had to [put off] the meeting.

cartes.ipa: wi ˈhæd tə ˈpʊt̬‿ɑːf ðə ˈmiː.t̬ɪŋ
cartes.aide: put off = reporter. Aussi : put the meeting off.

cartes.reponse: I can't [put up with] this noise anymore.
cartes.texte: I can't put up with this noise anymore.
cartes.ipa: aɪ ˈkænt ˈpʊt̬‿ˈʌp wɪð ðɪs ˈnɔɪz‿ˌen.iˈmɔːr
cartes.aide: put up with = supporter, tolérer.

cartes.reponse: The police are [looking into] the case.
cartes.texte: The police are looking into the case.

cartes.reponse: I [found out] that she'd left.
cartes.texte: I found out that she'd left.
cartes.aide: find out = découvrir, apprendre.

cartes.recto: They [canceled] the game because of the rain.
cartes.reponse: They [called off] the game because of the rain.

cartes.ipa: ðeɪ ˈkɑːld‿ˈɑːf ðə ˈɡeɪm bɪˈkɑːz‿əv ðə ˈreɪn

cartes.reponse: Please [go on] with your story.

cartes.recto: I'm trying to [reduce] my sugar intake.

cartes.ipa: aɪm ˈtraɪ.ɪŋ tə ˈkʌt ˈdaʊn‿ɑːn ˈʃʊɡ.ɚ

cartes.reponse: He [made up] an excuse.

cartes.reponse: She [turned down] the job offer.
cartes.texte: She turned down the job offer.

cartes.reponse: She was [brought up] by her grandparents.

cartes.reponse: Please don't [bring] it [up] again.

cartes.reponse: He didn't [show up] until ten.
cartes.texte: He didn't show up until ten.

cartes.reponse: She [takes after] her father.

cartes.ipa: ɪt ˈtʊk‿ɪm ˈmʌnθs tə ˈɡet̬‿ˈoʊ.vɚ ðə ˈbreɪk.ʌp

cartes.reponse: The teacher [handed out] the tests.

cartes.reponse: I'm trying to [give up] smoking.

cartes.reponse: Let's [go over] the plan once more.

cartes.reponse: [Drop by] anytime you're in town.
cartes.texte: Drop by anytime you're in town.
cartes.aide: drop by = passer (voir quelqu'un).

cartes.reponse: They [set up] a new company.
cartes.texte: They set up a new company.

cartes.reponse: They [made up] after the fight.

cartes.reponse: I can't [figure out] how it works.

cartes.reponse: I don't want to [let] you [down].

cartes.ipa: ˈsɑːr.i‿aɪm ˈleɪt aɪ wəz ˈheld‿ˈʌp‿ɪn ˈtræf.ɪk

paquets.accroche: Retrouve la particule, et sa logique : up, out, off, down…

cartes.aide: out = jusqu'au bout, épuisement : il n'y en a plus.

cartes.recto: Can you figure ___ how it works?
cartes.texte: Can you figure out how it works?
cartes.aide: out = faire apparaître, découvrir.
out = sortir, devenir public.
off = séparation, annulation, arrêt.
off = départ, on quitte le sol.

cartes.recto: The fire alarm went ___ at three a.m.
cartes.texte: The fire alarm went off at three a.m.

cartes.recto: Turn the music ___, it's too loud.
cartes.texte: Turn the music down, it's too loud.

cartes.recto: Write ___ the address before you forget.
cartes.texte: Write down the address before you forget.

cartes.aide: down = fixer par écrit.

cartes.recto: The car broke ___ on the highway.

cartes.recto: Calm ___, it's not a big deal.

cartes.recto: Drink ___ your coffee, it's getting cold.
cartes.texte: Drink up your coffee, it's getting cold.
cartes.aide: up = achèvement : jusqu'à la fin.
up = augmentation.
up = apparaître, arriver.

cartes.texte: Cheer up! It's not that bad.
cartes.aide: up = vers le haut, le moral remonte.
up = maintenir à niveau.
on = continuation.
on = tenir, rester en contact.

cartes.recto: Let's go ___ the plan one more time.
cartes.texte: Let's go over the plan one more time.
cartes.ipa: ˈlets ˈɡoʊ‿ˈoʊ.vɚ ðə ˈplæn ˈwʌn ˈmɔːr ˈtaɪm
cartes.aide: over = d'un bout à l'autre, révision.

cartes.aide: over = examiner sous tous les angles.
back = retour, réponse.

in = inclusion : je participe.

paquets.accroche: Deux phrases, un seul temps qui change : laquelle dit quoi ?

cartes.a: I've lived here for ten years.
cartes.b: I lived here for ten years.
cartes.question: Laquelle dit que tu y habites encore ?
cartes.aide: Le present perfect relie le passé à maintenant ; le prétérit coupe : c'est fini.
cartes.texte: I've lived here for ten years.

cartes.a: I've lost my keys.
cartes.b: I lost my keys.
cartes.question: Laquelle sous-entend que tu ne les as toujours pas ?
cartes.aide: Present perfect : le résultat compte maintenant (je n'ai pas mes clés). Prétérit : un fait passé, peut-être réglé depuis.

cartes.a: I've been waiting for an hour.
cartes.b: I waited for an hour.
cartes.question: Laquelle dit que tu attends encore ?
cartes.aide: Le present perfect continu étire l'action jusqu'à maintenant.
cartes.texte: I've been waiting for an hour.

cartes.a: It rained all day.
cartes.b: It's been raining all day.
cartes.question: Laquelle dit qu'il pleut peut-être encore ?
cartes.aide: Le present perfect continu va jusqu'à maintenant ; le prétérit parle d'une journée terminée.

cartes.a: He's been painting the house.
cartes.b: He's painted the house.
cartes.question: Laquelle dit que la maison est finie ?
cartes.aide: Present perfect : résultat achevé. Continu : l'activité, pas forcément terminée.

cartes.a: I've finished my report.
cartes.b: I finished my report an hour ago.
cartes.question: Laquelle donne le moment précis ?
cartes.aide: Un moment précis du passé (an hour ago) exige le prétérit.

cartes.a: When we got there, the movie started.
cartes.b: When we got there, the movie had started.
cartes.question: Dans laquelle avez-vous raté le début ?
cartes.aide: Past perfect : le film avait commencé avant votre arrivée.
cartes.texte: When we got there, the movie started.

cartes.a: When I arrived, she left.
cartes.b: When I arrived, she had left.
cartes.question: Dans laquelle as-tu pu la croiser ?
cartes.aide: Prétérit + prétérit : les actions se suivent. Past perfect : elle était déjà partie.

cartes.a: I was cooking dinner when you called.
cartes.b: I cooked dinner when you called.
cartes.question: Dans laquelle as-tu commencé à cuisiner après l'appel ?
cartes.aide: Prétérit : l'action suit l'appel. Continu : elle était déjà en cours.
cartes.texte: I was cooking dinner when you called.

cartes.a: They had been arguing when I came in.
cartes.b: They argued when I came in.
cartes.question: Dans laquelle la dispute a-t-elle commencé avant ton arrivée ?
cartes.aide: Past perfect continu : l'action durait jusqu'au repère passé.
cartes.texte: They had been arguing when I came in.

cartes.a: I had been working all day, so I was exhausted.
cartes.b: I had worked all day, so I was exhausted.
cartes.question: Laquelle insiste sur la durée de l'effort ?
cartes.aide: Le continu met l'accent sur la durée, le parfait simple sur le résultat.
cartes.texte: I had been working all day, so I was exhausted.

cartes.a: She works in London.
cartes.b: She's working in London.
cartes.question: Laquelle suggère une situation temporaire ?
cartes.aide: Le présent continu décrit le temporaire ; le présent simple, le permanent.

cartes.a: The train leaves at six.
cartes.b: The train is leaving.
cartes.question: Laquelle parle d'un horaire fixe ?
cartes.aide: Le présent simple sert aux horaires et programmes.

cartes.a: At eight, I'll have dinner.
cartes.b: At eight, I'll be having dinner.
cartes.question: Laquelle dit que le dîner sera déjà en cours à 8 h ?
cartes.aide: Futur continu : en cours à un moment du futur. Futur simple : le dîner commence à 8 h.

cartes.a: By June, I'll finish the book.
cartes.b: By June, I'll have finished the book.
cartes.question: Laquelle dit que ce sera terminé avant juin ?
cartes.aide: Futur antérieur : achevé avant le repère futur.
cartes.texte: By June, I'll finish the book.

cartes.a: This time tomorrow, I'll be flying to Boston.
cartes.b: Tomorrow, I'll fly to Boston.
cartes.question: Laquelle te place en plein vol à un moment précis ?
cartes.aide: Le futur continu montre l'action en cours au repère.
cartes.texte: This time tomorrow, I'll be flying to Boston.

cartes.a: In May, I'll have been working here for ten years.
cartes.b: In May, I'll work here.
cartes.question: Laquelle compte une durée déjà commencée ?
cartes.aide: Futur antérieur continu : durée qui court jusqu'au repère futur.
cartes.texte: In May, I'll have been working here for ten years.

cartes.a: Have you seen the news?
cartes.b: Did you see the news last night?
cartes.question: Laquelle parle d'un moment terminé et précis ?
cartes.aide: Last night : moment révolu, donc prétérit.

cartes.a: I was reading when the lights went out.
cartes.b: I read when the lights went out.
cartes.question: Laquelle dit que la lecture était déjà en cours ?
cartes.aide: Le prétérit continu pose le décor interrompu par l'événement.
cartes.texte: I was reading when the lights went out.

cartes.a: I've known her since college.
cartes.b: I knew her in college.
cartes.question: Laquelle dit que tu la connais toujours ?
cartes.aide: Since + present perfect : la relation continue jusqu'à maintenant.
